descriptionMarkdown:
This is Aurora.

Important: 
If you have any issues to start the ship, set the condition on the CONTROL PANEL to "OR" temporary.

Version 2.1:
- adjusted indicators to show low values correctly

Starship properties:
Size: 12(w)x438(h)
Weight: 860t
Cargo: 15x
Thrusters: 4x
Tanks: 50K
Energy: ~35MW/305MJ
Turrets: 24x gun,18x laser->42 total

It's ultra thin, but still it has it's own unique design.
It uses nuclear power and it manufactures own nuclear fuel!
It's self sustain and prevents any overloads of collectors.
Ship contains control panel where engines efficiency can be set.
Ship contains indicator system for levels of energy,fluids and ammo.
Ship contains blinking navigation lights.

© Designed by Velda
https://www.youtube.com/@VeldaGames/

My other ships:

Orion:

https://factorioprints.com/view/-P4oNjloO_WQswp5l7SP

Destiny:

https://factorioprints.com/view/-P3cRqFRICyZFkZUFVrz

This ship has advanced asteroid crushing and advanced thruster fuel manufacturing. So be sure you researched advanced asteroid processing.

This ship has width only 12tiles. It's very long and it's using vertical stacking for engines but in the same time it has its own unique design.
Ship was calibrated and tested on standard trips between Nauvis and Gleba/Fulgora. With default control panel setup (115) ship reaches 60% fuel consumption and 85% efficiency.

Ship has got implemented kovarex enrichment process, so you don't need to worry about refueling and energy for a very long time (indicator of uran supplies is also included). However, you will need to provide the ship with some uran 235 and 238 from the planet at the beginning and also build some solar panels to start the process of creating uran on the ship.

I personally flew 10-times from Gleba to Nauvis back and forth without any needs to stop for ammo replenishment or refueling - still in green numbers.
